title: Instance Quota
subtitle: Review and set the per-channel daily AI reply limit for each instance, alongside live sandbox concurrency usage.

layerHint.text: This page is the tenant's own reply quota (a self-limit, counted in replies). The platform's daily allowance per group / private chat lives on the
layerHint.after: page; both must allow a reply.

usage.concurrencyHint: In use {{active}} / limit {{max}}, admitted {{admitted}} in total, longest wait {{wait}}s

list.emptyHint: Create or claim an instance under Instances, and its quota shows up here.
list.loadFailed: Failed to load the quota list

dialog.batchTargets: The change is applied to each of the {{count}} selected instances one by one; a failure on one does not affect the others.
dialog.dailyLimitHelper: Daily AI reply limit per channel, 0 means unlimited. Setting it on the instance applies to every channel of that instance. Leave empty to keep the quota unchanged.
dialog.clearOverrideLabel: Clear the override and fall back to the inherited value {{value}}
dialog.clearOverrideLabelBatch: Clear the override and fall back to each instance's own inherited value
dialog.clearOverrideHelper: Once the instance-level override is cleared, the quota comes from the adapter level or the global config, and the daily limit typed above is ignored.
dialog.ceilingHelper: Only the platform owner can set this. Tenants may lower their quota but never exceed it; enter 0 to remove the ceiling.
dialog.ceilingLockedHint: The platform owner set a ceiling of {{ceiling}} for this instance. The quota cannot exceed it, nor be set to unlimited.
dialog.ceilingLockedHintBatch: The strictest platform ceiling among the selected instances is {{ceiling}}. The quota cannot exceed it, nor be set to unlimited.

errors.negative: The daily limit cannot be negative.
errors.overCeiling: The daily limit must not exceed the platform ceiling of {{ceiling}}.
errors.unlimitedBlocked: This instance has a platform ceiling of {{ceiling}}, so it cannot be set to unlimited (0).
errors.ceilingInvalid: The platform ceiling must be an integer no smaller than 0.
